Tolichowki Inspector Caught Accepting Bribe in Telangana

The Anti-Corruption Bureau (ACB) in Telangana apprehended a police inspector from Tolichowki for allegedly accepting a bribe of Rs 20,000. The bribe was reportedly given to allow late-night hotel operations.
